title: Hi from Samarkand!

before.predict: Look at the title. Who is the email from?

text.title: An email from Laylo
paragraphs: **Hello** Emma! Thank you for your email from London. My name is Laylo. I am eleven years old. I am a student at School 15 in Samarkand. Samarkand is a beautiful city in Uzbekistan.
This is my best **friend**, Madina. She is in my class. She is very funny! Bobur is her brother. He is not in our class. He is twelve. Bobur and Madina are my neighbours.

Our English **teacher** is Mrs Karimova. She is very nice. Every day she says, “Good **morning**, class!” We say, “Good morning, Mrs Karimova!” English class is my favourite. I am **happy** in English class. It is not difficult.
In Uzbekistan, we say “Assalomu alaykum!” to say hello. We say “Xayr!” to say **goodbye**. What do you say in England? Are you a student too? Please write soon!

tf: English class is difficult for Laylo.

mcq.q: How do Uzbek children say goodbye?

draw: Draw you and your best friend at school. Write two sentences: “I am … . My friend is … .”
fun_fact: The word “goodbye” comes from an old English greeting: “God be with you”.
